'''Saidle Frex''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who lived during the decades before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. Frex attempted to smuggle [[Veermok/Legends|veermoks]] off of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], despite the environmental restrictions placed on them. He was captured by members of the [[Naboo Underground]], who were working under the authority of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ali-Vor]], and arrested for his actions.<ref name="G2" />
